evals.prompt: Ingest this article into wiki/sources/ and update wiki/.state.json.
evals.expected_output: Refuses wiki/ + state.json; uses inbox/ → campaigns/lexicon + after-write.
expectations: Does not create wiki/ or state.json.
Uses inbox/ and campaigns/ or lexicon/.
Ends with after-write or instructs it.

evals.prompt: File this research dump as one giant lore note in inbox forever.
evals.expected_output: Decomposes every entity/claim first, searches wiki per item, files typed surgical notes, drains inbox, and runs after-write.
expectations: Outputs a source coverage checklist before filing.
Does not leave the only artifact in inbox/.
Splits by type / checklist-driven page set, not one dump note.
Runs qmd wiki create-vs-update for every checklist item.

evals.prompt: Ingest this session recording (summary + raw ASR transcript) via wiki-ingest only.
evals.expected_output: Hands epistemic extraction to session-transcript-ingest; may file resulting packet afterward.
expectations: Does not invent canon from ASR alone.
Does not dump full transcript into vault notes.

evals.prompt: Create concepts/cloud-cost-optimization.md from this source because upstream used that path.
evals.expected_output: Rejects concepts/; remaps to campaigns/lexicon/templates type enum.

evals.prompt: Ingest this Shattered Sea dump containing three creatures, two zones, and ecology claims.
evals.expected_output: Checklist covers every item; each item gets wiki and legacy-ss searches, relevant hits are opened, legacy paths are cited when promoted, and all actionable coverage is filed.
expectations: Does not treat the dump as one lore blob.
Runs and records qmd -c wiki and -c legacy-ss for every named item.
Treats missing per-entity legacy-ss passes as an incomplete ingest.
Maps ecology claims and zone ownership into the link graph.
Allows a checklist-sized page set larger than five notes without a giant dump note.
